data.wen_inquiry: Chief complaint: Acquired aplastic anemia with low platelets and haemoglobin not responding to conventional care; fatigue. Symptoms: marked fatigue; appetite loss and severe constipation (side effects); purpura; cold feeling below the ankles; hot palms and sweaty soles; insomnia with many dreams; pale complexion; moon-shaped face.
